capabilities: insert a default heading into new empty notes
rename files to match the first H1 heading on every edit
convert names to kebab-case and translate diacritics to ASCII
batch rename all files from the command palette
extras: Install requires cloning the repository and building with npm; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Filenames drift from note content as headings change, and renaming manually for every edit is tedious.
summary: File renaming plugin that keeps note filenames in sync with the first H1 heading, converting them to kebab-case with diacritic translation.
